main_measure.name: mean short-direction unusual move over the next 1 bar

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: > 0 with t >= 2 (and slope > 0); reject: < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of short-direction unusual move on abs(forecast)

decided_by: The main measure is above 0 with t >= 2 and the slope on abs(forecast) is above 0.
reading: Profile bars are read from the recorded regime ('unknown', the regime left when neither 'chop' veto fires) and up days from the raw scaled rise > 0; cases are every active bar with a next-bar return in its window, the coin's mean is over all its 1-bar returns in all windows, and the day-clustered t uses se = sqrt(G/(G-1) * sum over days of (summed deviations)^2) / n.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.003485 on the check folds against +0.005179 on every fold
